name: discord-plugin
description: Discord integration for AGNT - Send messages and upload files to guild channels OR user DMs (recipientType='user' + userId), delete the bot's own messages (single / purge-all / purge-recent, DM-safe and rate-limit-paced), auto-chunk >2000 char messages, Discord-safe attachment optimization (PNG->JPEG, GIF->MP4, video re-encode), role management, inbound message receiving (guilds + DMs), user lookup by username or ID (RESOLVE_USER), and DM setup diagnostics (TEST_DM). Bot->user DMs require the bot to share at least one guild with the user. Requires ffmpeg on PATH for attachment optimization.
author: AGNT

schema.title: Discord API
schema.description: Interact with Discord to perform various operations such as sending messages, managing roles, and uploading files. Long messages are automatically split into multiple chunks (Discord caps a single message at 2000 characters); splitting is code-block aware and emoji-safe.

action.description: The action to perform on Discord. RESOLVE_USER = look up a user by username or ID. TEST_DM = 5-stage diagnostic that verifies the bot can DM a user. ORCHESTRATOR_CHAT = bridge a message into AGNT's full orchestrator (the same engine that powers the main Annie chat) and return the reply + any generated image refs; conversationId (or channelId) keys persistent memory. DELETE_MESSAGE = delete the bot's OWN message(s) — one by messageId, or purge all/recent bot messages from a DM or channel. In a DM the bot can only delete its own messages (Discord platform rule).

conversationId.description: Stable conversation key for ORCHESTRATOR_CHAT memory. Same ID across calls = same persistent conversation. If omitted, derived from channelId (discord-dm-<channelId>) or userId. This is what gives the Discord bridge full conversation memory.

orchestratorModel.description: Optional model override for ORCHESTRATOR_CHAT (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-5'). If omitted, uses the user's default provider/model.

resolveMode.description: How to look up the user (RESOLVE_USER action). 'byQuery' searches a guild's member list by username/display name/nickname (needs guildId + userQuery). 'byId' validates a known user ID (needs userId).

userQuery.description: The username, global display name, or nickname to search for (RESOLVE_USER with resolveMode='byQuery'). Case-insensitive substring match by default; set exactMatch=true for exact match.

guildId.description: The Discord server (guild) ID to search within (RESOLVE_USER with resolveMode='byQuery'). Discord blocks global user search for anti-harassment, so searches happen per-guild. Enable Developer Mode -> right-click server icon -> Copy Server ID.

exactMatch.description: Require exact match of username / display name / nickname (RESOLVE_USER with resolveMode='byQuery'). Default: false (case-insensitive substring match).

dryRun.description: Run all TEST_DM checks WITHOUT actually sending a message. All stages up to messageSend will run, but the final send is skipped. Perfect for first-time setup verification without spamming DMs. Default: false.

recipientType.description: Where the action targets. 'channel' = guild text channel (uses channelId). 'user' = direct message to a Discord user (uses userId; bot must share at least one guild with the user). Applies to SEND_MESSAGE, UPLOAD_FILE, and DELETE_MESSAGE.

deleteMode.description: DELETE_MESSAGE mode. 'single' = delete one message by messageId. 'purgeMine' = delete EVERY message the bot authored in this DM/channel (up to scanLimit). 'purgeRecent' = delete the bot's last N authored messages (set count). In a DM only the bot's own messages can be deleted.

messageId.description: The ID of the message to delete (DELETE_MESSAGE with deleteMode='single'). Enable Developer Mode -> right-click the message -> Copy Message ID.

count.description: How many of the bot's most recent messages to delete (DELETE_MESSAGE with deleteMode='purgeRecent').

scanLimit.description: Max number of messages to scan back through when purging (DELETE_MESSAGE purgeMine/purgeRecent). Safety cap so a purge can't page forever. Default: 500.

deletePaceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between sequential deletes when purging (DELETE_MESSAGE). discord.js already auto-handles rate limits; this is extra spacing to stay well under the bucket. Default: 400. Set 0 for max speed.

userId.description: The Discord user ID to DM (when recipientType='user'). Enable Developer Mode in Discord (Settings -> Advanced), then right-click a user -> Copy User ID. Only used when recipientType='user'.

channelId.description: The ID of the Discord channel (for SEND_MESSAGE, UPLOAD_FILE, and DELETE_MESSAGE when recipientType='channel'). When recipientType='user' this field is ignored (use userId instead).

message.description: The message text. For SEND_MESSAGE: the Discord message to send (auto-split if over the 2000-char limit unless autoSplit is disabled). For UPLOAD_FILE: optional caption sent with the attachment. For ORCHESTRATOR_CHAT: the prompt sent to Annie's full orchestrator.

autoSplit.description: Automatically split messages that exceed the character limit into multiple sequential messages (for SEND_MESSAGE action). Splitting avoids breaking words, preserves fenced code blocks, and never slices emoji. Default: true. Set false to send as-is (Discord will reject content over 2000 chars).

splitLimit.description: Maximum characters per message chunk when autoSplit is on (for SEND_MESSAGE action). Capped at Discord's 2000-char hard limit. Lower it for a safety margin. Default: 2000.

splitDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between sequential chunks when a message is split (for SEND_MESSAGE action). Keeps chunks in order and avoids Discord rate limits. Default: 350. Set 0 for no delay.

numberChunks.description: Append a (n/N) counter to the end of each chunk when a message is split (for SEND_MESSAGE action). Default: false.

guildId.description: The ID of the Discord guild (server) (for ASSIGN_ROLE and GET_MEMBERS actions)

roleId.description: The ID of the role to assign (for ASSIGN_ROLE action)

memberIds.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs to assign the role to (for ASSIGN_ROLE action)

filePath.description: Absolute path to a file on disk to upload (preferred — avoids base64 bloat and ensures proper video/image previews). Either filePath OR fileData is required.

fileName.description: The name of the file as it should appear in Discord (for UPLOAD_FILE action). Optional when using filePath — defaults to the basename of filePath. Required when using fileData.

fileData.description: Base64-encoded file data (for UPLOAD_FILE action). Prefer filePath when possible — base64 uploads are slower and heavier. Either filePath OR fileData is required.

description.description: Optional alt text / description for the attachment (accessibility). For UPLOAD_FILE action.

spoiler.description: If true, mark the uploaded file as a spoiler (blurred until clicked). For UPLOAD_FILE action.

autoOptimize.description: Automatically shrink the attachment to fit under Discord's size cap before upload (UPLOAD_FILE via filePath only). Applies: PNG/BMP/TIFF -> JPEG Q88, GIF -> h.264 MP4, oversize video -> h.264 re-encode with a 720p/540p/480p downscale ladder. Lossy files (JPEG, MP4, WebP) already under the cap pass through untouched. Requires ffmpeg on PATH. Default: true — set false to upload raw.

targetLimitMB.description: Size ceiling in MB for auto-optimization (UPLOAD_FILE action). 10 MB is safe everywhere (free tier + legacy webhooks). Use 25 for current free-tier servers, 50 for Boost L2, 100 for Boost L3. Default: 10.

forceOptimize.description: Re-encode the attachment even if it already fits under the target limit (UPLOAD_FILE action). Useful for turning a huge PNG icon into a small JPEG. Default: false.

includeAvatarMeta.description: When true, include the raw Discord avatar hash and a resolved CDN URL for each member (for GET_MEMBERS action)

includeGlobalProfile.description: When true, include discriminator, global name, banner hash, and other global profile metadata (for GET_MEMBERS action)

trackRoles.description: Optional list of role IDs to flag members with an isTracked indicator (comma-separated for GET_MEMBERS action)

hashFields.description: Optional list of member field names to hash (comma-separated) for audit comparisons (for GET_MEMBERS action)

targetUserId.description: The ID of the user to ban (for BAN_MEMBER action)

banReason.description: Optional audit log reason for the ban (for BAN_MEMBER action)

deleteMessageDays.description: Number of days of messages to delete (0-7) when banning the user (for BAN_MEMBER action)

success.description: Indicates whether the Discord operation was successful

result.description: The result of the Discord operation. For SEND_MESSAGE: a single-message object, or when a long message was split, a chunked object with { chunked: true, chunkCount, messages: [...] } plus top-level pointers to the first message.

error.description: Error message if the Discord operation failed

schema.title: Receive Discord Message
schema.description: Listen for incoming Discord messages in a specified channel and trigger the workflow when a new message is received.

channelId.description: The ID of the Discord channel to monitor

author.description: The username of the message author

username.description: The display username of the author

avatarUrl.description: The avatar URL of the message author

authorId.description: The ID of the message author

channelId.description: The ID of the channel where the message was sent

guildId.description: The ID of the Discord server (guild)

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the message was created

attachments.description: Array of file attachments on the message
